---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Request

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

**Describe the solution you'd like**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Use Cases

**Who would benefit from this feature?**

- [ ] End users (facility bookers)
- [ ] Administrators
- [ ] Organization staff
- [ ] Developers
- [ ] Other: ___________

**When would this feature be used?**

Describe specific scenarios where this feature would be valuable.

## 🎨 Mockups/Examples (optional)

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other applications.

## 🔧 Technical Considerations (optional)

**Implementation suggestions:**

- Database changes needed
- API endpoints required
- UI components affected
- Performance impact

## 📈 Expected Impact

**How important is this feature?**

- [ ] Critical - Blocks major functionality
- [ ] High - Significantly improves user experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have improvement
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement

**Estimated user benefit:**

- Number of users affected: [e.g., all users, admins only]
- Frequency of use: [e.g., daily, weekly, rarely]
- Time saved: [e.g., 5 minutes per booking]

## 🌍 Internationalization

**Does this feature need translation?**

- [ ] Yes - User-facing text that needs Norwegian/English
- [ ] No - Backend only or no text
- [ ] Partial - Some text visible to users

## ♿ Accessibility

**Accessibility considerations:**

- [ ] Keyboard navigation
- [ ] Screen reader support
- [ ] Color contrast
- [ ] Mobile responsiveness

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, research, or information about the feature request here.

## 🔗 Related Issues/PRs

- Link to related issues or pull requests if any

## 📚 References

- Links to similar features in other apps
- Documentation or articles supporting this feature
- User feedback or requests

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

What needs to be true for this feature to be considered complete?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 📝 Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear use case
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
- [ ] I have described the expected impact
